O3.note: Seeds share the same 174 sub-goals, so the independent unit is the sub-goal, not sub-goal x seed.

verdict.O1: adequately powered for the observed effect; under-powered for effects < MDE
verdict.O2_O3_O4: very large effects (h > 0.6, cost -54%); power ~1.0 at n = 174
verdict.generalisation: 100 sessions from one benchmark (ToolBench G1) is enough for internal validity, not for external validity: add G2/G3, ToolRet and a real-LLM run
